title: Kaba languages - Wikipedia
text: The Kaba languages, also called Sara Kaba but not to be confused with the Sara languages, [1] comprise three to five languages of Chad and the Central African Republic. They are Bongo-Bagirmi languages of the Central Sudanic language family. The most populous Kaba languages are Kaba Deme and Kaba Naa (Kaba Na, Kaba Nar), spoken by about forty thousand people apiece.
